title: CO-OP MARKS AND CRIER MARKER GROW AT 4K
why: His order of 2026-10-09: the raid text reads like a shooter HUD, the same size on every screen, with distances as 120m. A teammate ping, a teammate Waypoint, the arrow to a teammate off screen, the Crier ring and countdown and the noise chevrons at the screen edge were drawn at their 1080p size on a 4K screen, and their distances read 120M. They now grow with the screen and read 120m, and the Crier countdown is no longer drawn over the open backpack. At 1080p only the unit letter changes.
now: On a 4K screen pings, teammate marks, the Crier countdown and the noise arrows are now full size, and distances read 120m.
